causal_agent: Cercospora arachidicola (Early leaf spot) / Cercosporidium personatum (Late leaf spot)
symptoms: Early leaf spot: Circular reddish-brown to dark brown spots surrounded by a bright, distinct yellow chlorotic halo
Late leaf spot: Circular small black spots on lower leaf surface without prominent yellow halo; cushions of dark black spores on underside
Spots coalesce rapidly leading to severe premature leaf drop, leaving bare stems and severely reducing pod size
lookalikes: Groundnut rust (which forms small raised orange-brown pustules on underside of leaves)
favourable_conditions: Prolonged cloudy humid weather (>85% RH) with frequent rainfall and temperatures around 25-28°C
season_or_growth_stage: Appears 35-45 days after sowing, peaking during pod filling (60-80 DAS)
monitoring_and_confirmation: Inspect bottom leaves 35-40 DAS for circular brown spots with yellow halos
prevention: Seed treatment with Carbendazim + Mancozeb (Saaf) @ 2 g/kg seed before sowing
cultural_management: Crop rotation with non-host cereals (bajra, sorghum, maize)
biological_management: Trichoderma viride seed treatment @ 10 g/kg seed and foliar spray @ 5 g/L

organic_options.treatment_name: Sour Buttermilk (Khati Chhash) + Neem Oil Extract
organic_options.preparation_or_formulation: Fermented sour buttermilk (1 L) + Neem oil 1500 PPM (40 ml) in 15 L pump
organic_options.dosage: 1 L buttermilk + 40 ml neem oil / 15 L pump
limitations: Helps slow fungal sporulation; under continuous rainy weather, standard approved fungicides are needed.

chemical_options.dilution: 30 to 35 g per 15-liter spray pump (400-500 g/acre in 150-200 L water)
chemical_options.timing: At first appearance of spots (usually 35-40 DAS); repeat after 15 days if cloudy humid weather persists
mixing_warnings: Do not mix with alkaline formulations.
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

chemical_options.dilution: 25 to 30 ml per 15-liter spray pump (200-250 ml/acre in 150-200 L water)
chemical_options.timing: At active leaf spot development for systemic eradicant action
mixing_warnings: Follow recommended dose; avoid excess concentration.
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

resistance_management: Rotate between multisite protectant (Mancozeb) and sterol biosynthesis inhibitor (Hexaconazole).
expert_referral_conditions: Contact local KVK agronomist or Kisan Call Centre (1800-180-1551) if infestation exceeds threshold.
